negative_similarity_safety.risk: A negative similarity multiplied by a factor below 1 would become less negative and reverse the intended category penalty.
negative_similarity_safety.formal_candidate_pool_check: Check every regenerated Text-to-Image Top-20 raw similarity before reranking.

metric_classification.supplemental_note: MRR@10 and NDCG@10 already exist in the frozen Baseline metrics and manifest. They are frozen repository supplemental metrics, not later recalculations and not PRD target metrics.

validation_evidence.scope_limit: The 24-query validation result describes Text→Image only and must not be presented as a bidirectional retrieval-system result.

representative_bad_case_evidence.scope_limit: Cause percentages and rule-fixable percentages describe only the selected 20 representative 3C cases and must not be extrapolated to all 3C errors.

reporting_constraints: Report the 24-query development evidence as Text→Image validation, not as a bidirectional system result.
Treat the 20-case cause and rule-fixability proportions as representative-sample findings only.
Report P@10 and R@10 as PRD primary frozen metrics.
Report MRR@10 and NDCG@10 as frozen repository supplemental metrics.
Image-to-Text uses the frozen Baseline Top-10 unchanged because no independent image-side category or attribute signal exists.
Do not use formal test50 results to adjust rules, pool depth, weights, labels, or evaluation definitions.
